correctness.rationale: For each a in algebraically closed characteristic eleven with a squared not four, the sextic factor has distinct roots and C_a has genus three. Three linearly independent pullbacks of elliptic differentials from the order-three quotient E0 and two conjugate order-two quotients E1 prove J(C_a) is isogenous to E0 times E1 squared. Hasse coefficients from quintic powers of elliptic cubic equations are a(a²+1)(a²−3) and 6a. These give all Newton slopes and p-ranks for all geometric a. The full Hasse-Witt matrix has entries 5a, a(a²+1)(a²−3), 5a on its antidiagonal blocks; its ranks give independently the a-number, since a-number is not isogeny-invariant. The standalone verifier ran and checked exact polynomial identities and nine rational smooth coefficients, not an infinite sampling argument.

originality.rationale: Narrow acceptance is limited to the exact characteristic-11 rank-two locus a² in {−1,3}, the absence of a rank-one stratum, and the entire Newton/a-number stratification of the classical D6 curve family. The explicit D6 model, elliptic quotient mechanism, superspeciality of a=0 and earlier classification of the same pencil's superspecial parameters at p=11 are covered prior facts and are not claimed as new. The earlier superspecial criterion detects Cartier matrix vanishing, not the nonzero mixed Newton strata. Inspected broad moduli papers do not give the special parameter equations. Searches showed no exact dominating result, but unindexed same-family tabulations remain a priority risk.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural moduli-locus classification, not a selected numerical sample. The exact four geometric mixed Newton parameters and proof that p-rank one never occurs describe the special arithmetic behavior of the full dihedral genus-three family in characteristic eleven. The elliptic quotient decomposition gives a structural explanation for the possible Newton polygons, and the separate Cartier calculation computes a-number, which cannot be inferred from the isogeny alone. The known superspecial endpoint is not offered as new value.
